description: This file defines the EmployeeLanguageService class within the OrangeHRM PIM Service namespace. The class manages an instance of EmployeeLanguageDao, providing a getter method with lazy initialization. It's part of a Human Resource Management System's plugin component, handling employee language data-related business logic.
